executionNote: This review environment exposed no Bash/execution tool (only Read/Grep/Glob). The three shell tests were NOT literally re-executed; they were verified by line-by-line static simulation, the authoritative PROP-005 ripgrep manual-read (done in-review), and by confirming the RED/GREEN evidence logs describe a genuine, internally-consistent failure->fix transition (pre-fix monitor.sh hardcoded LEDGER/ACCTS to myclaude defaults -> leaked @aiclipsvault; post-fix sources _instance_paths.sh). No live fresh run was performed.

prop005_manual_read.method: Read all four WORKER files (_instance_paths.sh, run.sh, producer.sh, monitor.sh) in full + ripgrep '\b(if|elif|case)\b' cross-referenced against 'claude|sonnet|clawrouter|anthropic|blockrun'.
prop005_manual_read.conclusion: Zero conditionals branch on model/provider identity. Every if/case in the worker layer branches on URL-empty, file-exists, EARN_MODE, TID-empty, ACTIVE==HANDLE, or LEDGER-exists. The only 'claude'/'sonnet' string matches in the worker files are path fragments (~/.claude/skills/...) and comments, not conditionals. clip-cli.sh (launcher, out of scope per REQ-005 carve-out) correctly still hardcodes 'claude --model sonnet' at line 33 and does NOT source _instance_paths.sh.

findings.issue: PROP-002 case 2 only asserts suffix+inequality for CLIP_QUEUE and CLIP_ACCTS; it never asserts CLIP_POSTED or CLIP_LEDGER are suffixed / differ from default. The ledger-suffix guarantee (the specific drain risk REQ-002 calls out) is only proven transitively by test_n_instance_distinctness.sh, not directly in the PROP-002 unit test.

PROP-008(a) spec asks for an 'mtime/content diff' on the default queue; the test substitutes a filename-SET comparison (documented, to avoid false-positives from the concurrent live cron). A content mutation of an existing default-queue file that preserved the filename set would go undetected. Low real risk because run.sh under a probe instance never references the default queue, but the assertion is weaker than the spec's stated method.

monitor.sh isolation is not total: section 3 always queries and prints the DEFAULT founder wallet address (xxKC33TY...) for ANY instance unless CLIP_WALLET is set, so running monitor.sh under a second/probe instance still emits myclaude's financial state. PROP-008 only asserts absence of the myclaude account handle (@aiclipsvault) and nonzero post count, NOT absence of the founder wallet line, so this leak is uncaught by the test. Acceptable under the spec's explicit wallet-deferral to REQ-006/PROP-006 (follow-on feature), but monitor.sh cross-instance isolation is partial, not complete.

All three worker scripts run under 'set -uo pipefail' with no 'set -e'. If _instance_paths.sh were missing/renamed, 'source' returns nonzero but execution continues; the next line (e.g. run.sh:21 QUEUE="$CLIP_QUEUE") then trips 'set -u' unbound-variable and exits. This is fail-loud (acceptable, not silent misbehavior) but relies on the downstream unbound-var trap rather than an explicit guard on the source result; a corrupted (but present, partially-defining) _instance_paths.sh could set some vars and leave others, producing a partial-config run.

positiveEvidence.verified: Unset ANICCA_INSTANCE -> _SFX='' -> queue/posted/accounts.json/ledger.jsonl byte-identical to the four pre-feature defaults.
ANICCA_INSTANCE=name -> '-name' suffix on ALL FOUR path types incl. ledger; 4 instances x 4 paths = 16 resolved, statically all distinct.
CLIP_LEDGER=${EARN_LEDGER:-...} -> explicit override wins regardless of ANICCA_INSTANCE.
Zero model/provider conditionals in worker layer (ripgrep + full manual read). clip-cli.sh launcher left untouched, correctly hardcodes claude/sonnet per carve-out.
Only calls into already-proven ig-reels-poster/post_reel.py + ig-account-create/scripts; producer uses earn-clip-rewards; no new/unproven signup path.
Both run.sh and monitor.sh source _instance_paths.sh and consume per-instance CLIP_* paths; missing probe files -> 'nothing to post' / 'no ledger yet' / empty accounts, no cross-instance file read.
All three workers source the single _instance_paths.sh; no duplicated path-derivation logic. monitor.sh old hardcoded LEDGER/ACCTS fully replaced (not shadowed) by CLIP_LEDGER/CLIP_ACCTS.
